summary: CohortASM is a web page and code module for managing student placement selection rules, options, and behaviors in a placement/timetable system. It provides configurable parameters for how students can select placements (PRs), including maximum selections, allowed services, allocation constraints, and permissions for viewing and entering data related to placements. The system incorporates business logic, UI components, validation mechanisms, and workflow for both administrators and students.
purpose: To enable administrators to configure how students select placements (PRs), constrain and validate these selections, and provide options for duplicate selection, destination allocation, service inclusion, and control over visibility and entry permissions. The system's form and workflow govern entry, validation, update, and display of these configuration options.

workflows.name: Configure CohortASM
steps: Configure maximum selections per student (dropdown and custom input)
Specify duplicate PR selection, rank withheld PRs, and view classmate stats (checkboxes)
Configure allowed services: select and move between included and not included lists
Set allocation constraints: campus-only or section-only
Set visibility and entry permissions for students (various checkboxes)
Set selection period with start and end date/time (calendar extenders and text boxes)
Validate input via UI validators and custom client/server logic
On save, values are updated and validated
Error and warning panels display validation messages

workflows.name: Student Selection
steps: Student selects PRs based on system configuration
Selection options limited by maximum, service inclusion, and allocation constraints
Validation ensures selections are within allowed values and periods

business_rules: MaxStudentPRSelections must be between 1-40 or specific allowed values
Custom selection input must be validated for range (1-40)
Start and end dates must be valid and conform to format; start must not be after end
If maximum selections is 0, selection period dates/times are cleared
If allowed service selection is enabled, at least one service must be included
Duplicate PRs and destinations may be allowed or disallowed per checkbox setting
Students may only view or enter data as permitted by admin configuration
validations: CustomValidator: Saved choices exist dates cannot be blank
CustomValidator: Dates exist max selections not N/A
RegularExpressionValidator: Start/end date must match date format
RegularExpressionValidator: Start/end time must match time format
CustomValidator: Close selector date required with open selector date
CustomValidator: Close selector date must be after open selector date
CustomValidator: Time period must be valid
Client-side JavaScript validates range and required fields
calculations: If allowed services are enabled and selected, join IDs to comma-separated list
Calculate start/end datetime from text and time fields, default time handling
Sort included and not included services alphabetically
Checkbox helper logic determines value display (YES/NO)
conditions: Selection fields enabled only if screen is editable and user is authorized
Campus allocation constraint only visible if campuses exist
Service selection list visibility toggles based on checkbox
system_behavior: Loads relevant JavaScript and validation logic
Handles asynchronous postback for form updates
Displays errors and warnings in panels
Controls visibility of edit buttons based on user role
Updates form data on save with validation
dependencies: AJAX Control Toolkit for UI components
UserSession object for permissions and context
exceptions: Start/end date or time invalid format
content_gaps: No detailed database table schema for Timetable or ServiceCode
No explicit UI screenshots or wireframes
No business rules for edge scenarios documented
